entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, um, I hope you can help. I ordered a helmet and... I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. The order number is... VF789012. I was looking at the policy online and it's all so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. I'm here to make this as simple as possible. I've pulled up your order now. I see the ProFit Helmet purchased about a month ago. What specifically is the issue with it?
It's the color, really. I was trying to pick something highly visible for safety, but it just doesn't look as bright as it did on my screen. I haven't even taken it out, the box is still unopened.
I completely understand. Getting the right color for visibility is very important. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for this item. One moment.
Okay, I see you received the helmet 29 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days, so you are well within that window. I can definitely approve this return for you.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. And Alex, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. We really appreciate your loyalty. To make this even easier, I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label, so the shipping is on us.
Wow, really? That's so helpful, thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Diana. Thank you.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
